name: Reverence
overview: Scripture reveals reverence as a profound respect and awe directed toward God, His holy presence, and those He has appointed in authority. Abram's humble posture before God (Genesis 17:3) and God's command to Moses to remove his shoes on holy ground (Exodus 3:5) illustrate the deep honor due to God's holiness. The people's trembling at Mount Sinai (Exodus 19:16) further emphasizes reverential fear. This respect extends to human relationships established by God, including honoring parents (Exodus 20:12) and respecting rulers and judges as representatives of divine authority (Exodus 22:28).
